regime: Broad sell-off: metals forced selling alongside a volatility spike and tech-led drop
takeaway: Gold fell about 2.6% to near $3,626 and silver about 4.4% to near $43 late Thursday, with miners down too, so the site's forced-selling, silver-under-stress and gold-downtrend checks all match; the gold/silver ratio rose to about 84.4. At the same time the Nasdaq dropped 2.25% and the VIX jumped about 16% to 28.4, matching the tech-led selloff and volatility spike patterns. Bond yields stayed just above 5% and the dollar near a 19-month high, so this looks like selling across the board rather than a flight into bonds.
